rule: FAIL when any critical check reports a problem. The legacy checks V01-V18 are in requirements-validation-report.json and are summarised by W02.

checks.title: The authoritative baseline is reconciled: every requirement of the R6, R7 and v4 baselines has a disposition, every change has a recorded authority, and no requirement or P0 priority disappears
The legacy compilation (V01-V18) passes and its readiness is READY: no unresolved contradiction, valid DAG, complete coverage
Every P0 requirement of the baseline is in the verification plan and has acceptance obligations; plan-readiness is READY with no permit
Operational definitions cite real requirements and name their deciding evidence
State machines are well formed: declared states and events, sourced transitions, reachable states, deterministic guards, Saved entered only by a confirmation
Invariants cover every required group, cite real requirements and name tests of known kinds and evidence categories
Every required Rehearsal 7 defect class is mapped; gaps carry an owner decision request; quotes are verbatim in the permitted evidence files
The dependency lock is the approved release set: every component is a stable release of echelon-current at the recorded version and manifest digest; no forbidden framework
Interfaces name existing contracts and locked systems, with operations and a verification method
The execution plan schedules every timed task with an estimate and reports whether each topology fits the window (fit itself is freeze condition FG-07)
Owner decision requests are well formed: every proposed amendment only adds to its obligation's baseline text
The risk register's ratings are in range and every link names something in the package
No approval record was written by an agent: the pinned approvals file holds only operator records (RDP-003)
The package contains no application implementation: no source file of an application language under requirements-compiled/v4
The verification plan and the reconciliation are compiled from the committed v4 baseline

Every normative invariant and lesson test, and a WebKit twin of every Chromium test where the requirement names WebKit, iPad or Safari, is bound in the plan on an obligation that requires its category
